title: Sony Alpha 7C II Compact Full-Frame Camera
purpose: Lightweight full-frame street editorial, fashion portraiture, and travel reportage powered by a 33.0MP Exmor R BSI CMOS sensor, dedicated AI autofocus unit, and cinematic S-Cinetone color science in a compact rangefinder-style chassis.

sensor_and_optics.camera_system: Sony Alpha 7C II Compact Full-Frame (33.0MP Exmor R BSI)
sensor_and_optics.sensor_type: 33.0MP 35mm full-frame back-illuminated Exmor R CMOS sensor with BIONZ XR & AI Processing Unit
sensor_and_optics.full_frame_equivalent: 40mm street editorial standard field of view
sensor_and_optics.lens: Sony FE 40mm F2.5 G (SEL40F25G compact prime)
sensor_and_optics.dynamic_range: 15.0 stops dynamic range with 14-bit ARW RAW and S-Cinetone / Creative Look FL
sensor_and_optics.shutter: Electronic front-curtain mechanical shutter to 1/4000s, electronic to 1/8000s, 7.0-stop IBIS

lighting_and_exposure.primary_lighting: Dynamic urban street light, diffused café window illumination, or high-contrast architectural twilight
lighting_and_exposure.light_transport: S-Cinetone cinematic skin tone modeling, Creative Look filmic contrast, gentle highlight roll-off, deep clean shadow retrieval

surface_rendering: Exquisite 33.0MP full-frame resolving power: fine epidermal skin texture, detailed clothing weave, brushed metallic accessories, and crisp urban architecture
AI Processing Unit tracking lock guaranteeing pin-sharp iris focus even during dynamic walking or glancing angles
G-series optical purity with circular 7-blade aperture rendering smooth, circular bokeh without onion-ring artifacts
depth_and_optics: Shallow full-frame planar isolation separating subject from bustling city backgrounds at f/2.5-f/2.8
Natural rectilinear geometry across the versatile 40mm focal length
Spontaneous eye-level rangefinder-style framing combining documentary agility with full-frame optical presence

execution_directive: Enforce 33.0MP full-frame BSI capture, AI-locked eye acutance, cinematic S-Cinetone skin tones, compact street rangefinder perspective, and natural full-frame subject separation, shot on Sony Alpha 7C II.
